name: Rheydt (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Rheydt (a castle above a black cross and red and yellow bars).
history: Flag of a former municipality: the city of Rheydt was merged with Mönchengladbach and Wickrath into the new city of Mönchengladbach on 1 January 1975.

features.role: Rheydt arms — castle, cross and bars
